title: Suffixes -ity, -ist · Roots cred, duc/duct, ver, corp, gen, log/logy, phon, therm · Trade Routes: The Silk Road
goal: Read, spell, and use words with *-ity* and *-ist*; learn the remaining eight commonly-useful roots (completing all 20); run a big heart-word review sweep (Fry 201–250); connect the trade theme back to the Indus Valley spiral (5.04, 5.09).
newToday: suffix *-ity* ("state/quality of") and *-ist* ("a person who does/ believes in"); roots *cred* (believe), *duc/duct* (lead), *ver* (truth), *corp* (body), *gen* (birth/produce), *log/logy* (study/word), *phon* (sound), *therm* (heat). Tier-2 words: *route*, *exotic*.
review: *aud, graph/gram, ject, mit/mis* — one example word each.
time: 30–45 min — the densest session in the level; it's fine to split the root table across two sittings if needed, reviewing the rest next session's warm-up instead of rushing. **Materials:** paper, pencil, timer.
